headline: Kuura Strand Turns Colonial as Pari Peak Ignites
war_summary: Since our last edition, Kuura Strand has completed its turn: where the Colonials lately held a single toehold among Warden posts, they now command four of that region's six strategic bases, though the fighting there cools visibly from the night's peak. Pari Peak has newly caught fire, flags turning at Pariah and Camp Surista with losses accelerating on both sides and one post left in no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse remains the war's great furnace, sixty-four base changes on the day and fresh movement as this report closed, Spirit Watch and Frostmarch the busiest grounds while two ruined posts stay unreclaimed. Marban Hollow keeps up its seesaw at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, and Stlican Shelf saw steady traffic at Breaker Town into the small hours. Olavis Wake and the Nevish Line have gone markedly quieter, and Gutter rests in Colonial hands with its earlier storm spent. This is the war's 658th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
